info.name: Atlassian Get the Common Ancestor Between Two Commits

params.name: repo_slug
params.description:
This can either be the repository slug or the UUID of the repository,
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{repository UUID}`.

params.name: revspec
params.description: A commit range using double dot notation (e.g. `3a8b42..9ff173`).

params.name: workspace
params.description:
This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID
surrounded by curly-braces, for example: `{workspace UUID}`.

items.docs: This API endpoint retrieves the common ancestor commit between two specified commits in a Bitbucket repository. By providing the workspace identifier, repository slug, and a revspec parameter that identifies two commits (typically in the format "commit1...commit2"), the operation returns information about the most recent commit that exists in both commits' histories.
